Monastiri boat arrival: search_visitor and uhnw liked it; sceptic and funding_parent objected. Ruling: keep the sourced boat-or-road fact, drop the unsupported prediction.

Getting to Paros: uhnw wanted private arrival instead of buses; funding_parent and planner_couple (primary) praised the stairs, luggage and older-guest lines. Ruling: keep those lines, trim bus detail to essentials, add no private-logistics or transfer claim (deferred).
Scale: uhnw (200 to 400 guests) is outside the brief's 40 to 150 reader. Ruling: one sentence pointing larger weddings to combining spaces or the Greece guide; no change to the venue set.
Early CTA after the table: sceptic called it pitch before proof (low); it is conditional ('When you have a shortlist'). Ruling: keep; no change for cro-specialist.
Non-Australian legal steps (search_visitor, Singapore): outside the brief's Australian reader. No change.

Prices, best month: search_visitor wanted a ballpark price and a named month. No prices (Nic sign-off rule) and no best month as fact; the FAQ gets a direct line from the Naxos and Smartraveller facts only.
